//: D4.49 frozen defect: NORMALISATION_NOT_IDEMPOTENT. Captured once from the D4.48 engine (commit below, a local commit of the D4.48 patch applied to GitHub 223bfc821) with sweep.mjs variablesFor(type, {profile}) and no AI provider. Never regenerate. The normaliser capitalised role ALIASES as well as canonical roles, so one pass turned a renderer's lower-case 'the recipient' or 'a principal sum' into a capitalised alias the document never defines, and a second pass replaced that alias ('Principal sum' became 'Borrower sum').

shipped_clauses_a_second_pass_changes.shipped_text:
The Receiving Party shall use Confidential Information solely for Evaluating whether to enter into a commercial supply arrangement with the Disclosing Party, and for no other purpose. Where this Agreement operates as a mutual non-disclosure agreement, each Party may use the other Party's Confidential Information only for that same permitted purpose. Disclosure is permitted only as follows:
(a) to those of its personnel, professional advisers, and auditors who need the Confidential Information for the permitted purpose and who are bound by obligations of confidence no less protective than those in this Agreement, the Recipient remaining responsible for their compliance
(b) where disclosure is required by Applicable Law, by a court or tribunal of competent jurisdiction, by a regulator, or by the rules of a stock exchange to which the Recipient is subject
(c) where disclosure is compelled under the preceding limb, the Recipient shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other Party prompt written notice before disclosing so that it may seek a protective order, and shall disclose only the minimum required while using reasonable endeavours to obtain confidential treatment
(d) no other disclosure is permitted, and a disclosure made in reliance on this clause does not otherwise release the Confidential Information from the obligations of this Agreement

shipped_clauses_a_second_pass_changes.shipped_text: Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, the Lender agrees to lend to the Borrower, and the Borrower agrees to borrow from the Lender, a Principal sum of ₹3 (Rupees Three Only) ('Principal Amount'). The Borrower shall utilise the Principal Amount solely for Evaluating a possible investment by the receiving party in the disclosing party's business, and shall not divert funds for any other purpose.
